title: Dfyn Network — vanilla UniV2 + legacy farms/vaults; live value holder-only, E-U ~$0
closed_reasons: All 1,827 pairs are stock UniswapV2Pair (identical bytecode per chain); 92/1,788 Polygon pairs have raw donation-excess but every excess token is unpriced spam (priced total $0.00008; exit liquidity <$0.30); zero excess on any core token
skim() reverts (ds-math-sub-underflow) on the 3 deficit pools; no funded pair contains a fee-on-transfer/rebase token
Farms (227 curated + 15 factory-deployed) are per-user StakingRewards variants: getReward()=0 and withdraw() reverts for zero-stake caller; rescueFunds onlyRewardsDistribution
Vaults/chest/prediction market gate claims on caller's own accounting (balanceOf/ledger); no public sweep
feeTo (protocol fees) is a plain EOA on Polygon/Fantom; OKC feeTo = 0
key_facts: Polygon factory 0xE7Fb3e833eFE5F9c441105EB65Ef8b261266423B: 1788 pairs, feeTo=feeToSetter=EOA 0x74665b21461f8d9b23bab7d599bfd7566a95fd70; Fantom 35 pairs; OKC 4 pairs (feeTo=0)
Full scan (block 95381964): Polygon 1695 funded pairs = $339,396.92 reserves (llama), 92 junk-excess pairs ($0.00008 priced total), 3 deficit pools; Fantom $136.29 / OKC $22.11, no excess/deficits
Ownership split: farm-staked LP $198,905.13 (H-O), feeTo EOA LP $1,639.00 (P), free LP $139,031.78 (H-O)

BYOF factories enumerated: 0x28cfcda0469d0ff70da48ee774e90970bd86155c (16 farms), 0x34df3b41c2e48d73d912963d12675dc22f8bd352 (4), 0x57791b5257a8b95d6c0c0a6ad947ffecc5e77953 (12); 15 farms not in the curated registry, all staking Dfyn pairs
Curated farms hold 6,564,712.17 DFYN ($972.18) + 943.83 ROUTE ($36.53); missing farms +3,601.95 DFYN ($0.53)
Vaults 183,111.88 DFYN ($27.11) + 7,342.83 ROUTE ($284.17); vDFYN chest 4,228,238.80 DFYN ($626.03); prediction market 1,982.57 POL ($203.42, treasury 417.19 POL)
Polygonal factory holds 100.00 USDC with no sweep (S); WETH9 clone 0x4c28f48448720e9000907bc2611f73022fdce1fa wraps POL 1:1 (POL balance == totalSupply 457,629.36), pools fairly priced at POL parity
eDAI/eUSDC pairs' apparent excess was a decoder artifact: balanceOf returns 96 bytes; first word == reserve exactly
caveats: Farm leftover H-O/P split not enumerable per-staker; whole $1.0k counted as P (upper bound)
683 of ~1,050 pair tokens have no DefiLlama price; unpriced pools valued $0
First Phase-2 scan run had a full-return int() decode bug that falsely flagged 2 eDAI/eUSDC pairs; corrected and re-run
H-O pool value assumes LP/stakers still control keys and farm withdraw paths stay callable
Category totals include the H-O/P ambiguity on ~$1.0k farm leftovers
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Dfyn Network: stock UniV2 with only worthless spam-token donation excess ($0.00008 priced across 92 pairs) and per-user-only farm/vault/chest/PM claims; the ~$341.8k live value is LP-holder (H-O), protocol-fee EOA (P) and depositor recoverable.
